title: Integrate Monorepo Storybook And Playwright
description: Create a monorepo-integrated Storybook and Playwright setup at the repository root, following the existing bun + nx + VS Code conventions already used by other projects. The root .storybook/main.ts currently exists but is empty. The result should behave like the other projects in this repo: Nx targets, bun-driven commands, VS Code launch/test friendliness, and end-to-end validation. Reuse existing patterns from package-local Storybook and Playwright setups where appropriate, but make the root integration actually run. Work end-to-end until the new setup is validated with real commands.
